name: fennec-dev
description: Shared Claude Code tooling for Eclipse Fennec development. Ships the fennec-quality-review skill (code-quality review of a Fennec OSGi repository against SOLID principles adapted to OSGi/DS and Eclipse Foundation guidelines) and the bnd skill (jar/OSGi bundle analysis via the bnd CLI: manifests, imports/exports, DS components, baseline/diff, wrap, bndrun resolve).
